goal: Familiar answers, clever original clues; never sacrifice solver enjoyment for fill uniqueness

layout.threeLetterWords: Usually 0-2, sometimes 3 if all answers are familiar; not a hard limit

wordPolicy.approval: Human editorial review before any new answer is added
wordPolicy.rareTerms: Only when fairly clued and strongly supported by crossings
wordPolicy.adultOrObsolete: Replace in a later curated grid revision; avoid in all new publications

reviewNeeded.DERE: Dialect spelling with weak general familiarity
reviewNeeded.DER: Foreign-language grammatical article without accessible crossings
reviewNeeded.DES: Abbreviated proper name rather than everyday vocabulary
reviewNeeded.DEL: Abbreviated proper name rather than everyday vocabulary
reviewNeeded.PAP: Uncommon filler for a casual crossword
reviewNeeded.ORGY: Adult meaning; not a default family-friendly answer
reviewNeeded.PIMP: Adult association; not suitable as default fill
reviewNeeded.PISS: Vulgar; not suitable as default fill
reviewNeeded.EVA: Proper name which needs a specific clue
reviewNeeded.DONNA: Proper name rather than general vocabulary
reviewNeeded.FRO: Very common in a phrase but rare alone
